deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: Permanently delete your WSFA account. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.deletedBody: Your brew journal and brew logs, saved and liked recipes, follows, collections, notifications and push notification tokens.
deleteAccount.anonymisedBody: Your name becomes "deleted user" and your email, phone, photo, bio, password and sign-in methods (including Google) are removed. Recipes, posts and comments you published stay visible, shown as from a deleted user.
deleteAccount.brandNote: If you own a brand, transfer or delete it first.
deleteAccount.dialogBody: You will be signed out and won't be able to sign in to this account again.

errors.ownsBrand: You own a brand. Transfer it to another member or delete it before deleting your account.
